# CVar scriptProfile
* [History](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/CVar_scriptProfile?action=history)
* [Purge](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/CVar_scriptProfile?action=purge)
* [Talk (0)](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Talk:CVar_scriptProfile?action=edit&redlink=1)
Enables CPU profiling for lua scripts.
0
0
Off
1
On
This CVar requires a UI reload.
In-game, type the following
```
/console scriptProfile setting
/reload
```
Alternatively, you can exit wow, open the Config-cache.wtf file, and add the following line:
```
SET scriptProfile setting
```
